approvers: Nobody else, I sign it myself
reason: I spend about 900 euro a year on snagging damage and pay it from the job contingency. Paying 19 euro a m2 on every job to avoid that makes no sense for a one-man outfit, and I buy from people I have known for years.
objection: I've never seen it used in Malta. Show me a local job. And the cost is far more than the damage I actually pay for.
instead: Carry on with no protection, clean and polish at snagging, and take any damage out of the contingency.
would_change_my_mind: A client or main contractor who insists on it in the spec and pays for it, plus a local job I can go and look at.
